intents.name: team_creation
intents.answer: NoteStandard enables seamless team collaboration. To create a team: 1. Open the Teams tab. 2. Tap 'Create Team'. 3. Enter team name, description, and optional logo. You become the Team Owner and can immediately invite members.

intents.name: invite_members
intents.answer: To invite colleagues to your team: 1. Go to Team Settings > Members. 2. Tap 'Invite Member'. 3. Enter their username or email address and select their role (Admin, Member, or Guest). An invitation will be sent to their NoteStandard inbox.

intents.name: team_roles
intents.answer: NoteStandard supports 4 team roles: Team Owner (full control, billing, member management), Team Admin (can invite/remove members, manage team folders), Member (can create/edit shared team notes), and Guest (view-only access to assigned notes).

intents.name: shared_workspace
intents.answer: Teams share a dedicated workspace folder where members can create joint notes, collaborate in real time, leave inline comments, and track revision history across shared projects.

intents.name: team_chat
intents.answer: Every team includes a dedicated Team Chat channel. Members can send messages, share files, pin important announcements, and start group audio/video calls directly within the team workspace.

intents.name: team_activity_feed
intents.answer: The Team Activity Feed logs all recent member actions including note edits, new uploads, member joins, and role changes, keeping the entire team aligned.
